intro.title: Blue Jade Stone
intro.description: Blue Jade is among the rarest forms of jade and a symbol of calm and peace. Its effect is calming and restorative, like a thin veil of gently moving clouds covering the moon. Its color ranges from pale to medium blue, and sometimes a pale bluish-green. It is commonly used to calm emotional turmoil and restore balance.

tabs.tab1_description:
Blue Jade Gemstone is a rare stone that can be both grounding and uplifting, allowing us to explore the polarities within ourselves and our beliefs. It is a stone that sings of peacefulness and harmony, demonstrating how to live in balance with oneself and the greater world. Blue Jade is a wonderful tool for enabling us to hear our Highest Self and Spirit Guides and to follow their wisdom, even if it contradicts tradition. Blue Jade fosters us to let go of life's trivial dramas and to instead prioritize our pursuits of personal and universal peace.

Blue Jade promotes patience, supporting those who feel helpless or hopeless in the face of uncontrollable circumstances to maintain their composure. It improves mental abilities from both hemispheres of the brain, increasing the capacity for rational thought and the ability to determine the best course of action. It is a stone of slow but steady progress, allowing one to view the world from a higher vantage point in order to avoid becoming mired in life's trivial dramas.

Blue jade is a "dream stone," relieving the mind of negative thoughts and irritability and calming it. It stabilizes the personality by integrating the mind and body, thereby stimulating ideas and making tasks less difficult and simpler to execute. When placed on the forehead, it induces lucid dreams. Jade enhances dream recall and facilitates the release of suppressed emotions through the dreaming process.

Blue Jade has a calming, reassuring energy that is especially beneficial during times of prolonged stress or sudden crisis. It aids us in maintaining an objective stance and preventing our emotions from running amok. Instead, blue jade encourages us to remain calm, seek out practical solutions, and find good people who can assist us in restoring peace to our lives.

Blue Jade can also assist us in recognizing that chronic stress is, in large part, a choice, and that we can make alternative decisions that, over time, lead to serenity. These transformations are not instantaneous and require a great deal of patience to achieve. If we sincerely desire true peace, Blue Jade promises to assist us at every turn.

This is an excellent stone for meditating with and combining with other stones with psychic powers and channeling abilities. The deeper you delve into yourself, the greater your comprehension of your purpose and soul's purpose on this planet. As you discover the light within yourself, consider and utilize your channeling abilities. Your true desires, motivations, and passions begin to flow out of you through a channel of abundance and love.

Blue jade crystal releases self-imposed limitations and aids in keeping one's ideals and desires, thereby facilitating ambition and the materialization of those thoughts. Jade imparts confidence, self-assurance, independence, and self-sufficiency.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Blue Jade gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Blue Jade. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Throat Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Blue jade bestows clarity with knowledge and wisdom. It makes you make excellent decision makers and effortlessly follow your dreams. With the Blue jade worn correctly on your body, your communication skills are enhanced.

As a profound support stone, blue jade assists physicians, nurses, veterinarians, and all other healers with practical diagnosis and application. Blue jade engraved into the shape of a religious symbol is encouraging to military personnel.

Blue jade can also be worn by anyone suffering from a thyroid disorder, respiratory disorder, hormonal imbalances, mood changes, or persistent infections.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Blue Jade gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Blue Jade gemstones.

 

Blue Jade Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The most notable deposit is located in California, the United States, where the Vonson blue jade variety is found. Blue Jade can also be found in Guatemala and Japan.

Observe their Color:

Jade blue color can range from light to dark and may contain green or gray undertones. The hue and intensity of blue in blue jade can be affected by factors such as the presence of mineral impurities and the location where the stone was extracted.

Notice their Clarity:

Blue jade can vary in transparency from opaque to translucent. In general, jade gemstones are distinguished for their translucency as opposed to their complete transparency. Nonetheless, clarity can vary from stone to stone, and some blue jade specimens may be more translucent than others.

Examine their Inclusions:

Due to the presence of mineral inclusions and impurities within the stone, they frequently have a slightly hazy or cloudy look. These natural characteristics are regarded as part of blue jade's allure and beauty.

See their Shape:

Blue jade is typically polished into various shapes, including oval, round, cushion, emerald-cut, cabochon, pear, and square.

Check the Carats:

For Blue Jade of gem quality, the raw Blue Jade is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Blue Jade weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Blue Jade is sold by weight, Blue Jade prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Blue Jade has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Blue Jade:

Due to treatments the Blue Jade stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Blue Jade do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Blue Jade gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Blue Jade are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Blue Jade from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Blue Jade gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Blue Jade gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Blue Jade is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The Blue Jade comes in pale to mid-blue or pale bluish green. However, a good quality natural Blue Jade is in dark blue color.

Cut

Blue Jade stones can be in different shapes. The best quality blue jades have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, and saturation.

Carat

Blue Jade of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Blue Jade are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Blue Jade rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Blue Jades are opaque or slightly translucent and lack complete clarity. It has a waxy sheen and a silky feel.

Traders deal in Blue Jade gemstones that are synthetic to natural but are treated/heated and color enhanced, so you must buy only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputable lab.

Blue Jade Gemstone Price

The price of Blue Jade gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. Despite its rarity, this gemstone is surprisingly affordable, but it must be purchased untreated in order to take advantage of its many properties.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Blue Jade has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Blue Jade stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Blue Jade gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 555 to INR 1,025 (USD 7 to USD 12).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Blue Jade?

The best way to check the authenticity of Blue Jade is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Blue Jade are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Blue Jade carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Blue Jade is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Blue Jade have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Blue Jade, but if you find flaws, then your Blue Jade is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Blue Jade are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Blue Jade. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Blue Jade, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Blue Jade from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Blue Jade. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Blue Jade. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Blue Jade Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

When cleaning blue jade, which has a Mohs hardness of 6.5 to 7, care must be taken to prevent scratches. However, it possesses exceptional durability and resistance to cracking. Even though, the use of ultrasonic and steam cleaners is not recommended.

Warm, soapy water is the best cleaning solution for blue jade.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can wash it with soapy water and use a soft toothbrush or cloth to remove stains, dirt, etc. You can read in detail in the Quality & Price Section.

mainEntity.name: How to use and wear Blue Jade gemstone?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the best results, use the stone as a Ring or Pendant and it has to be worn as per Rudraksha Ratna Science Therapy, RRST, which is a scientific healing method devised by Sakhashree Neetaji. mainEntity.name: What rules or precautions need to be followed to wear Blue Jade?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need to follow any precautions if you are wearing the Blue Jade as per RRST.

mainEntity.name: When to wear Blue Jade gemstone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can wear Blue Jade gemstone everyday as per RRST and ideally start to wear it on a Friday morning.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep Blue Jade in my pocket to receive benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Blue Jade will activate and work only if it is in contact with your body at the correct position. To experience 100% results from Blue Jade you have to wear it as per RRST. Please consult our RRST counselors for guidance.

mainEntity.name: Does heated Blue Jade work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, heated Blue Jade does not work.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to re-energize Blue Jade?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have worn the Blue Jade continuously you may not need to re-energize it. It is advisable to energize it if you have not worn it for an extended period of time. You can follow the steps mentioned in the Benefits Section.

mainEntity.name: How do you identify the original Blue Jade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best way is to get a lab test certificate from reputed labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper care, the effects of Blue Jade will last for generations. The majority of the time, they balance the chakras, we learn the lessons and align with the planets, and we may no longer need them after a period of time.
